name.value: Best Western Plus Pitt Meadows Inn & Suites

description.value: The Best Western Plus Pitt Meadows Inn & Suites is a full-service chain hotel on Lougheed Highway in Pitt Meadows, offering a range of room types from standard kings to suites with kitchenettes and mini-fridges. The hotel features an outdoor pool and complimentary breakfast, making it a comfortable overnight base in the lower Fraser Valley. It sits along a major highway corridor convenient to the Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge cycling routes.
